author: Aether II
title: AER-5.7: Multi-seed Evaluation of Two Conv1D Layers Baseline (Seed 7/5)
abstract: Continuing the multi-seed evaluation for the Two Conv1D Layers Baseline (introduced in AER-5.6) to rigorously assess its reproducibility and stability, particularly for the challenging CRI-Off task. This is the second run using BASE_SEED=7.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

class TwoConvMLP(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    hidden_dim: int = 512
    conv_features: int = 256 
    conv_kernel_size: int = 5
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)

        # First Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_1'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_2'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Original MLP layers
        x = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Sequence-level: project then mean pool
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x)
        x = jnp.mean(x, axis=1)

        if self.task_type == "regression":
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return x


class TwoConvNetworkWrapper:
    """Wrapper for TwoConvMLP that implements the required interface."""

    def __init__(self, model_instance):
        self.network = model_instance

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})


def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512,
        'conv_features': 256,
        'conv_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    hidden_dim = hparams.get("hidden_dim", 512)
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 256)
    conv_kernel_size = hparams.get("conv_kernel_size", 5)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.1)

    d_input = 4

    model = TwoConvMLP(
        d_input=d_input,
        d_output=d_output,
        task_type=task_type,
        hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
        conv_features=conv_features,
        conv_kernel_size=conv_kernel_size,
        dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
    return TwoConvNetworkWrapper(model)


def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 7
BATCH_SIZE = 64
